visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman wearing a professional white blazer and crop top stands by a floor-to-ceiling window in a bright room. A stylist is seen carefully adjusting her hair and clothing while she looks out at a hazy city skyline featuring a tall skyscraper in the distance. (2) A vibrant montage shows a crowd of people outdoors and moving up an indoor escalator. Many of them are waving happily at the camera and wearing red identification lanyards. The lighting is natural and bright, conveying a sense of public excitement. (3) The woman stands on an indoor stage holding a black microphone, speaking with an emotional expression to a large audience. Behind her is a soft pink backdrop with MAYUKI CHOU printed in red. The setting is a large, well-lit studio space with industrial ceilings. (4) Several audience members are captured in close-up shots, smiling broadly and making peace signs towards the camera. One person holds a handheld white sign with a chili pepper illustration and the text 葳老板的辣雞湯. (5) The woman interacts directly with her fans, holding hands with a young woman and giving a warm hug to another. The camera captures these moments in medium close-ups, highlighting the genuine emotional connection and the speaker's sophisticated attire. (6) A grand group photo session occurs with dozens of people seated and standing in a massive hall. Everyone is smiling and holding up promotional signs. The camera zooms out to reveal the full scale of the massive crowd.
